claims.text: The hotel is directly connected to Roppongi Hills, which houses high-end shops and restaurants, a cinema, an art museum and an observatory.

findings.quote: directly connected to Roppongi Hills, a cultural hub which houses 250 high-end shops and restaurants, a cinema, an art museum and an observatory

claims.text: The hotel is a short walk from Roppongi Station and provides easy access to areas such as Ginza and Shibuya.

findings.quote: The hotel is just a 3-minute walk from Roppongi Station and provides easy access to popular areas such as Ginza and Shibuya
findings.note: A 3-minute walk counts as a short walk.

claims.text: The design incorporates subtle Japanese aesthetics with rich mahogany furnishings made with natural woods and fabrics.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Tokyo incorporates subtle Japanese aesthetics into the design and offers rich mahogany furnishings made with natural woods and fabrics

claims.text: Rooms feature high ceilings, furniture by B&B Italia and light earth-tone colors and textures.

findings.quote: Featuring high ceilings, furniture by B&B Italia and light earth-tone colors and textures, these spacious hotel rooms offer the ideal environment for relaxation.

claims.text: Rooms have a work desk with Arne Jacobsen's Oxford chair and beds with Egyptian cotton linens by Frette.

findings.quote: a large work desk equipped with designer Arne Jacobsen’s Oxford™ chair and a king-sized bed with plush Egyptian cotton linens by Frette
findings.note: Covers both the desk chair and the Frette linens.

claims.text: Room bathrooms have a deep soaking tub that fills within five minutes.

findings.quote: each bathroom has a deep soaking tub that fills within 5 minutes

claims.text: Suite and club room guests have access to the Grand Club, a private lounge on the 10th floor offering check-in and checkout, a personal concierge, breakfast, evening cocktails and canapes.

findings.quote: enjoy access to a private lounge on the 10th floor. The lounge offers check-in and checkout service, a personal concierge, a meeting room, breakfast, evening cocktails, canapés and refreshments.
findings.note: Appears under the Grand Club Lounge section, which says it is for suite and club room guests.

findings.quote: the Grand Club is a private lounge located on the 10th floor
findings.note: Confirms the lounge name and floor.

claims.text: Nagomi Spa uses Indigenous elements and open spaces to create a sense of comfort and wellbeing.

findings.quote: Nagomi Spa offers a peaceful and serene retreat for fitness and relaxation, where Indigenous elements and open spaces provide the ultimate sense of comfort and wellbeing.

claims.text: A family suite comes with a children's tent, plushies and decorations, and a Japanese-style bathtub.

findings.quote: Enter a world of imagination with a children’s tent, plushies and decorations, soak up to the shoulders in our Japanese-style bathtub

claims.text: Wedding venues include the Grand Chapel and a Shinto Shrine ceremony room.

findings.quote: including our Grand Chapel and Shinto Shrine ceremony room

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants and bars include Japanese, Edo-mae sushi, French bistro and steakhouse options, plus a jazz lounge with live music.

findings.quote: Our 10 stylish venues offer unique menus, including Japanese, Edo-mae sushi, French bistro, and steakhouse options, as well as a jazz lounge where you can enjoy live music.

claims.text: Roku Roku serves Edo-mae-style sushi and sashimi using seafood selected each morning from markets across Japan.

findings.quote: Roku Roku restaurant serves Edo-mae-style sushi and sashimi using premium quality seafood selected each morning from local markets across Japan.

claims.text: The top-floor suite has a private heated outdoor pool and a sundeck with sweeping views of Tokyo.

findings.quote: top-floor suite featuring a 138-square-meter (1,485 square feet) private heated outdoor pool and a sundeck with sweeping views of Tokyo

claims.text: A Japanese-style suite has a private Japanese garden, a tatami mat dining room and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Tokyo.

findings.quote: Recharge in Japanese style in a luxurious 188-square-meter (2,023 square feet) suite featuring a 12-square-meter (129 square feet) private Japanese garden, tatami mat dining room and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Tokyo.

claims.text: A corner room on the 21st floor has its own private Japanese garden.

findings.quote: corner room on the 21st floor with two luxurious queen-sized beds and a 30-square-meter (322 square feet) private Japanese garden

claims.text: Nagomi Spa and Fitness has a natural red granite indoor swimming pool surrounded by a hardwood deck, and an illuminated whirlpool adorned with platinum tiles made in Italy.

findings.quote: Nagomi Spa and Fitness features a natural red granite indoor swimming pool (20 m by 7 m) surrounded by a hardwood deck. The beautifully-designed illuminated whirlpool is adorned with platinum tiles made in Italy.
findings.note: Matches all elements of the claim.

claims.text: Rooms on the 11th to 20th floors offer views that can include Tokyo Tower, the skyline and Mt. Fuji on a clear day.

findings.quote: room on the 11th to 20th floors, with a variety of views including the iconic Tokyo Tower, Tokyo’s sparkling skyline and Mt. Fuji on a clear day

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the entry-level rooms have 20-year-old decor, though they have been well cared for.

findings.quote: All the trappings of 20-year-old decor are present in the entry-level rooms—and although the rooms’ vibe is a bit passé, they've been cared for very well over time.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes that because of the hotel's size, guests may not get the personalized attention of a smaller property.

findings.quote: Grand is indeed the key word when describing its size, and as such, guests may not get the personalized attention to detail of a smaller property.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy urban location may not suit those seeking tranquility.
